items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined all week, expectation he will not go.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP Wednesday/Thursday; sources via McManus/Garafolo.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thins vs Nacua-led Rams; Hurts volume may shift.

items.text: Rams get back Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to play Sunday vs Eagles as Smith likely out; McVay expects him after limited-to-full practice progress.
items.why: Groin/hip soreness resolved enough; no IR, short-term view.
items.implication: Rams WR1 returns; Adams/others share drops; strong matchup upside.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury sustained/aggravated in Week 3; out at least 4 games (eligible Week 9 after bye).
items.why: Hamstring; coach Moore confirms no surgery but multi-week recovery.
items.implication: Saints RB committee expands; Etienne out vs ATL/MIN/NYG/PIT.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren TNF vs CLE: 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; top-10 play.
Ravens Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full participation on Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Both cleared/trending to full roles Week 4.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed out for season, will undergo neck surgery after Week 2 injury; not career-threatening per LaFleur.
items.implication: GB WR committee; Watson/Golden/Moore elevated ROS.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining Packers WRs

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
Fresh ETR ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker notably #3 overall; also Parker Washington #22, Saquon #30.
items.why: Role/schedule/injury-adjusted ROS value in Chiefs offense.

items.text: Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst relative to opportunity so far.
items.why: Actual opportunity data shows limited high-value looks.
items.implication: Fade until role expands; aligns with Berry hate.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%/13% 3rd downs; SEA 2nd-fewest YPC allowed.
items.why: Poor usage profile + tough run D.
items.conflict: Any volume hope vs actual low participation

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% career target share/34 ypg with Penix; under 8 pts in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.why: Historical low usage with Penix + current underperformance.

items.text: LOVE Trevor Lawrence @ CIN: 19+ fantasy pts in 8/9 recent games; highest Week 4 O/U 51.5; prior success vs CIN.
LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: 36% target share last without Mitchell (likely out again); 78% catch rate/9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ ypr.
items.why: Elevated volume without Mitchell + soft matchup.

items.text: LOVE George Kittle vs DEN: climbing target share/routes (27% W3); Evans day-to-day ribs; DEN 8th-most TE yards allowed.
items.why: Rising usage + potential Evans absence + matchup.
